verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an agent framework like AutoGen, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The only related item is a 'Logging: Log traces and internal messages' feature, which is an adjacent capability for observing your own runs, not a way to disable vendor usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
